column1: # homm2 constants work list - numeric constants kept on purpose, one row each,
# with the reason. Every clang-tidy magic number in code, a local table or a
# declaration is open until it is written as a name (an enumerator, a named
# constant, NULL) or a row here keeps it numeric; files config/reviews/constants.tsv
# marks third-party are not counted. `homm2 verify constants --list [FILTER]`
# prints the open ones; the floor never rises (`--update-floor` lowers it).
# Columns (tab-separated; every field is an fnmatch glob, `*` matches anything;
# the first matching row wins): file owner spelling group detail reason.
# owner is the enclosing function, group the finding's category (code,
# local-table, declaration) and detail its source line.
# adventure, world and AI: ADVMGR, EVENTS, Viewwrld, DRAWING, HERO, AI, ARMYGRP, SPELLAI, PHILAI

column6: Retail sample-suffix table: the wsnd sample variant each of the ADVMGR_CURSOR_SAMPLE_COUNT cursor sounds loads.
Cheat digit: the decimal value the INPUT_SCAN_0..INPUT_SCAN_9 key types, folded into giCheatSeq by CHEAT_SEQUENCE_RADIX.
Large-map radar scale: ADVENTURE_RADAR_SIZE / MAP_DIMENSION_LARGE pixels per cell as the float retail stores (no integer name).

The odd ticks of the UPDATE_ANIMATION_PHASES cycle, which advance the odd animation columns.
Retail layout tables: the creature icon positions of the bottom hero view and the positions used for one to five occupied army slots (-1 unused).
game::RestoreCell's unused last argument: each retail call site passes its own tag, which the callee never reads.
Retail puzzle reveal order: the PUZZLE_PIECE_COUNT piece indices in the order obelisk visits uncover them.

Tileset frame table: the object frame of each wide or shadowed adventure object (X_LOC2, OBJNMULT, OBJNDSRT, OBJNWATR, OBJNRSRC), the frame its erase redraw starts from, and the wide X_LOC2 object's cell offsets by frame.
Army-slot permutation: slot indices 0..4 (ARMY_GROUP_SLOT_COUNT) that centre one to three stacks and spread secondary and tertiary stacks, selected by those stack counts.
Artifact primary-stat bonus: the retail amount each artifact adds to that HERO_PRIMARY_* stat.
Unused local arrays sized as the retail stack frame reserves them.
Ground tile shape (giGroundShape & WORLD_GROUND_SHAPE_MASK) grouped onto the GROUND_FRAME_* view-world frame it draws.
Per-scale pixel offsets of the town flag, the town and hero icon and the mine letter for SCALE_INDEX_FAR, _MIDDLE and _NEAR.
Large-map radar scale: ADVENTURE_RADAR_SIZE / MAP_DIMENSION_LARGE pixels per cell as the float retail stores (no integer name).
Retail castle wall tables: the screen x/y of the four wall sections per faction and the frame offset of each wall damage state.
Retail land mobility by the army's slowest creature speed (LAND_SPEED_COUNT entries).
Combat grid row index: each row's limit is the COMBAT_AI_CASTLE_BOUNDARY_ROW_n of the same row.
Casualty fraction just below one: the first troop keeps one creature unless the whole group dies.
Two rings of adjacent hexes: steps past the first COMBAT_DIRECTION_ADJACENT_COUNT walk the second ring.
Unused local arrays sized as the retail stack frame reserves them.
Saved bShowIt slots: the retail frame reserves three and the move loop uses the first.
Retail initial value of the attack-bonus globals, which GetTurnAIVars rewrites every turn.
Dimension Door reach: seven cells either side of the hero, the half-width of the 15-cell adventure view a human casts into.
